newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean supermarket sales rise in March.
newsitem.headline: Chilean supermarket sales rise in March.

text.p: Chilean supermarket sales rose 9.1 percent in real terms in March over the same month last year and were up 17.6 percent in nominal terms, the National Statistics Institute (INE) said.

The institute polled 556 establishments throughout Chile with three or more cash registers, compared to 539 in the same month in 1996. In the year to March, 29 such establishments have closed and 46 have opened, INE said.

Industry analysts typically use the Chilean Supermarket Association (ASACH) trade group's figures on sales growth as the most reliable barometer of the sector's growth. On Friday ASACH reported 5.9 percent real growth in the sector in March over March 1996, and 3.6 percent growth in the first quarter.
